paper_title: Predictions for Axion Couplings from ALP Cogenesis
suggested_experiment_name: CAST2017 + HB stars + ADMX (compilation in ALP cogenesis paper, Fig. 1)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 1
notes: This is a theory paper (Co, Hall, Harigaya 2020, arXiv:2006.04809) predicting ALP coupling TARGETS from the ALP cogenesis mechanism (kinetic misalignment baryogenesis + dark matter). It does NOT present a new experimental exclusion limit or a new sensitivity projection. Figures 1-3 show predicted coupling bands (e.g. g_agamma ~ 1.8e-11 GeV^-1 * c_agamma * (ma/meV)^{1/2} for photons, analogous formulas for nucleons Eq. 3.15 and electrons Eq. 3.18) overlaid with EXISTING limits (CAST, HB stars, ADMX, ABRACADABRA, LUX, white dwarfs, red giants, neutron star cooling) and EXISTING projections (IAXO, MADMAX, DM Radio, CASPEr, DARWIN) all taken from prior literature. The green prediction bands are theory targets, not exclusion limits, so no data points are extracted.
